changelog: Several tenants per hangar in private instances (acn_instan), admin-defined limit; placeable exit door; panel stays open; restart-safe.
French by default with an in-game language switch; much more detailed admin panel with teleports and live rental management.
First release: rent a hangar, steal and dismantle vehicles, press scrap blocks and truck them out.
Lockpicking, unscrewing and scrap press minigames.
